recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Meet Live Updates: Pointed Fingers Or Alliance Unity? All Eyes On Delhi Meeting
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **23** opposition parties are expected to meet in Delhi on Monday to discuss their strategy for the upcoming state and national elections. The meeting, called "Janbandhan," will focus on uniting against the **BJP** and addressing differences between alliance partners.  The **Congress**, **AAP**, **DMK**, and **TVK** are among the parties expected to attend.  **Mamata Banerjee** of the **TMC** is likely to raise concerns about attacks on her party's leaders in Bengal, while **John Brittas** of the **CPI(M)** will address alleged political understanding between the Left and the **BJP** during the Kerala polls.

recent_articles.title: Bihar MLC polls: NDA eyes 9 seats as political heirs enter the race | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Several prominent figures in Bihar are vying for the 10 MLC seats up for election on June 18th. **Nishant Kumar**, son of former CM **Nitish Kumar**, and **Deepak Prakash**, son of RLM chief **Upendra Kushwaha**, are expected to secure berths from their respective parties, while **Chirag Paswan** must choose among his nephew **Seemant Mrinal**, brother-in-law **Ved Prakash Pandey**, and former MLC **Hulash Pandey**.  **Jitan Ram Manjhi** is reportedly seeking a seat for his son **Praveen Kumar Suman**, who is already an MLC and minister. The RJD faces a dilemma between choosing **Tej Pratap Yadav**, **Rohini Acharya**, or outgoing party member **Sunil Singh**.

recent_articles.title: Bihar CM woos investors with amended package, says govt.’s top priority is ensuring safety - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the Chief Minister of Bihar, emphasized the government's commitment to ensuring the security of businessmen and boosting industrial growth in the state. He inaugurated a business conclave organized by the **Bihar Chamber of Commerce and Industries** to mark its centenary year. The CM highlighted the "Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Package-2025" aimed at attracting private investment, while assuring investors that their safety is paramount. Choudhary also addressed concerns about crime and caste politics, stating that criminals are not defined by their background and the government will prioritize investor security.

recent_articles.title: Setback for NDA as RJD wins MLC byelection in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** won the Bhojpur-Buxar Legislative Council seat in a byelection, defeating the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** candidate. **Sonu Rai**, representing the RJD, secured victory with 2,486 votes, while his opponent, **Kanhaiya Prasad** of the JD(U), received 2,146 votes. The RJD has attributed their win to alleged manipulation and fraud in the electoral process.

recent_articles.title: Nitish and BJP have no moral right to speak on dynastic politics, says Tejashwi Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the opposition in Bihar's Legislative Assembly, criticized **Nitish Kumar** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for their involvement in dynasty politics following the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet**.  Yadav argued that both the **BJP** and its allies are engaging in dynasty politics, citing examples like the inclusion of sons of former Chief Ministers in the new cabinet.

recent_articles.title: BJP attacking Bengali culture, pride: Kejriwal; Modi won’t have his way in Bengal: Tejashwi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arvind Kejriwal**, former Delhi Chief Minister and convener of the **Aam Aadmi Party**, joined the Trinamool Congress campaign in West Bengal on Sunday, addressing three rallies in Kolkata and Howrah.  His visit coincides with the final days of campaigning for the second phase of the Assembly elections, scheduled to conclude Monday evening. The AAP recently experienced a setback as seven of its MPs switched to the **Bharatiya Janata Party**.

recent_articles.title: Poll bugle to fall silent across Tamil Nadu on Tuesday evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Political parties** in Tamil Nadu are concluding their intense campaigning ahead of the Assembly election on April 23rd.  Polling will begin at 7 a.m. that day, with all political functionaries and party workers not eligible to vote required to vacate the area by 6 p.m. on Tuesday. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and other prominent leaders from various parties have campaigned in the state, while the Chief Electoral Officer has outlined strict regulations for the period leading up to the election.  These include restrictions on public gatherings, vehicle usage, and the establishment of polling booths.

recent_articles.title: Double murder in Bihar, but BJP, JD(U) vying for CM seat: Tejashwi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)**, criticized the ruling **BJP** and **Janata Dal (United)** for their focus on a Chief Minister seat while lawlessness prevails in Bihar.  He condemned a double murder in Araria, alleging police inaction and highlighting rising crime rates under the current government. Yadav urged the government to prioritize youth aspirations and fulfill teacher recruitment promises.

recent_articles.title: In Bihar, the prohibition law has become a joke, says Tejashwi Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the **opposition** in Bihar, criticized the state government's 10-year prohibition policy, accusing it of being "institutional corruption" and enabling a multi-billion rupee illegal liquor market. He cited data showing an increase in seizures and consumption despite the law's implementation, alleging that the government has failed to curb illicit liquor trade and instead is promoting corruption. **Yadav** also pointed out that the prohibition policy has disproportionately targeted poor communities and led to deaths from spurious liquor.

recent_articles.title: Tejashwi challenges Bihar CM, deputy CMs for a public debate over State’s progress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tejashwi Yadav**, leader of the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)**, criticized the **Nitish Kumar-led NDA government** in Bihar, claiming it has failed to improve various sectors.  He cited statistics showing low literacy rates, income levels, and investment compared to other states. He also pointed out high crime rates, poverty, unemployment, and pollution levels. The **BJP** and **JD(U)** defended the government's record, arguing that Bihar has flourished under their leadership.

recent_articles.title: CAG empanelled auditors to audit urban local bodies (ULBs): Bihar Deputy CM Vijay Sinha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar**'s government has decided to audit all urban local bodies (ULBs) using **CAG** empanelled auditors. Deputy Chief Minister Vijay Kumar Sinha stated that this decision is a part of the state's zero-tolerance policy towards corruption and aims to improve transparency in governance. The auditing will be conducted according to National Municipal Accounts Manual provisions and cover 19 municipal corporations, 89 municipal councils, and 154 nagar panchayats.  The government also plans to develop new townships and redevelop existing ones to promote urbanisation and provide "clean city, green city" initiatives.
